name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-10-27, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.82 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
